messages:
ravi: quick sanity bench for new model bring-up — llama2-7b (q4_0) and mosaic-7b (q8x4). prefill+decode single-stream microbench across a100/h100 in eu-west/us-east.

ravi: summary (batch=1, seq=2048 prefill, 512 decode)
```
model,gpu,region,prefill_ms,decode_ms,tokens_sec,$/1M
llama2-7b,q4_0,a100,420,85,1200,$9.5
llama2-7b,q4_0,h100,310,62,1650,$6.8
mosaic-7b,q8x4,a100,460,92,1100,$10.4
mosaic-7b,q8x4,h100,330,70,1500,$7.6
```
bench-bot: run_id=run_3123456789 status=complete
kevin: nice. what's the kernel choice? auto or fast-attn?
ravi: used auto-kernel selection (prod-like). logs attached.
kevin: do we have kv-cache hit assumptions? batch=1 so minimal.
maria: any quality regressions from q8x4/q4_0 vs fp16? quick rouge/headline check?
ravi: quick lr eval on 1k prompts: llama2 q4_0 ~ -0.9% bleu vs fp16, mosaic q8x4 ~ -1.7%. rough but within expected.
ella: can you convert tokens/sec -> $/1M calc? how computed?
ravi: $/1M = (1_000_000 / tokens_sec) * (gpu_hour_price / 3600). used prices: a100=3.8/hr, h100=5.5/hr
ella: thanks. looks like h100 is consistently better $/1M here for these seq shapes.
kevin: agree. next step: run a sustained 1h multi-qps sweep with kernel force=fast-attn and batch up to 4.
ravi: yep scheduling a follow-up. tagging @eng-infra for region capacity check :eyes: 
ops-bot: scheduled job run_3123456790 queued on eu-west-1, est start +12h
ravi: will post full artifact when done. :thumbsup:
